description: N5/C3 round 2 targeted triage of the weakest design verdicts

audit_completeness.instructions: The named record-and-field mapping is sufficient to reconstruct the whole decision chain for an important protected action, from the initiating proposer through authority, policy, human approval, execution, receipt, canonical outcome and any exception

criteria.true: Every chain question is answered by a specific recorded field, status history is an ordered append-only trail, and all records are correlated
criteria.false: Some material step of the chain is still unrecorded, unattributed, only inferable, or not correlatable

agent_boundary.instructions: The explicit refusal set prevents any agent actor from deciding, prevents self-approval, prevents two agents from satisfying each other's requirement, and prevents approval authority from being supplied by a role label, request body or query string

criteria.true: Human-only decisions, self-approval refusal, requester-agent eligibility resolution and server-side-only authority resolution close every listed indirection
criteria.false: A realistic input still lets an agent approve, lets a requester approve itself, or lets a caller inject approval authority

privacy_controls.instructions: The C3 state controls stop protected health information, clinical narrative, direct identifiers and credential material from being persisted

criteria.true: Parameter values are never stored, evidence and receipt fields are bounded reference tokens with credential refusal, no free-text field exists, and subject references are pseudonymised
criteria.false: A realistic input can still persist PHI, an identifier, prose or a secret in C3 state

tenant_branch_isolation.instructions: The explicit tenant and branch controls, including the cross-branch authority rule and the immutable scope columns, prevent cross-tenant and cross-branch approval, decision, execution and exception access

criteria.true: Scope comes only from verified claims and the server-side registry, the branch authority rule is enforced at decision and execution, and row-level security plus immutable scope columns hold in the database
criteria.false: A caller can still reach another tenant's or another branch's approval or exception state

residual_vector.instructions: If this design still fails, which single vector is the most likely cause

criteria.agent_requester_attribution: Agent requesters are only exercised through a trusted server-side path that does not yet exist as a verified credential
criteria.authority_snapshot_freshness: The authority snapshot can be stale between decision and a later execution window
criteria.digest_collision_or_canonicalisation: Parameter canonicalisation or digest handling could bind an approval to the wrong parameter set
criteria.execution_receipt_evidence: The receipt or evidence reference is a pointer whose truth depends on the typed operation
criteria.exception_ownership_drift: The linked W3 work item could drift out of sync with the exception case semantics
criteria.human_factor: A human approver approves without reading the parameters

residual_risk.instructions: How much residual risk remains after revision 2 before implementing this as a bounded synthetic slice
